name: xiaoyuzhou-podcast-outline
description: Plan an episode of a Chinese-language podcast for 小宇宙 and other podcast apps: the episode angle and title, a segment outline with timings and questions, the cold open, guest preparation, show notes with a timestamped timeline, and sponsor read placement. Use when asked 播客提纲怎么写, 小宇宙单集策划, 播客 shownotes, 采访嘉宾提纲, 播客开场白, 时间轴怎么写, or outline a podcast episode in Chinese. Produces three title options, an episode brief, a timed outline with questions and follow-ups, a cold open script, a guest briefing, show notes with timeline placeholders, and a disclosure check.
